summary: Iteration 13 - Employee Invite Flow Testing Complete. All 15 backend tests passed. Full invite flow verified: create worker -> verify token -> accept invite -> worker can login. UI tests passed for login page, admin login, team page, invite dialog, signup page, and invite setup flow.
passed_tests: Admin login with admin@churvox.com / Admin123! works
Wrong password correctly rejected (401)
Non-existent user correctly rejected (401)
POST /api/team/workers creates worker with status:'invited' and returns invite_link
Invited worker cannot login before accepting (401 - random password)
GET /api/invite/verify/{token} returns valid invite details
POST /api/invite/accept activates worker account
Worker can login after accepting invite
POST /api/team/resend-invite/{worker_id} resends invite with new link
Invalid invite token correctly rejected (400)
Accept with invalid token correctly rejected (400)
POST /api/team/import-csv imports workers from CSV
CSV import skips invalid rows (missing name/email, bad email format)
CSV import rejects missing file (400)
GET /api/team/workers returns list with status field (invited/active)
POST /api/auth/register creates employer account
Login page loads with Admin link at bottom
Admin link navigates to /admin/login
Admin login page works correctly
Team page shows CSV Import and Invite Worker buttons
Team page shows worker status badges (Pending/Active)
Invite Worker dialog has name, email, phone fields
Signup page has all required fields (name, email, business, password)
Invite setup page shows business name and email
Invite setup page accepts password and activates account
Success page shown after invite acceptance
Worker can login after accepting invite via UI
Churvox logo renders correctly (PNG, no black background)
critical_code_review_comments: Note: Invited workers get 401 (not 403) when trying to login because password check happens before status check. This is acceptable security behavior - doesn't reveal email existence.
seed_data_creation: Created test workers during testing (prefixed with test_* and csv_worker*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 verified the full employee invite flow: (1) POST /api/team/workers creates worker with status:'invited' and returns invite_link, (2) GET /api/invite/verify/{token} validates token, (3) POST /api/invite/accept sets password and activates account, (4) Worker can then login normally. CSV import via POST /api/team/import-csv works with multipart form data. Team page shows Pending/Active badges. PWA InstallPrompt component exists but can't be tested in Playwright (beforeinstallprompt won't fire). MOCKED: Email invites (logged to console + stored in invite_emails collection), SMS delivery, MYOB sync, Stripe billing.
